instagram_caption:
Jesus, why did they pick someone else again?

Another final round, another email that starts with thank you for your time.

He wanted a timeline. What he got was honest instead of comfortable. "Longer than you want. Shorter than it feels. And you will not waste it."

Ecclesiastes 3:1 says there is a time for everything, a season for every activity under the heavens. Including this one. Including the waiting one nobody puts on a CV.

If you are between things right now, the season is not a verdict on you.
